proposal.description: The 5-bit run count is widened to the 6-bit threshold width by putting the pad bit on the wrong (LSB) side, so the S_RUN trip compares twice the faulted-cycle count with trip_run.
proposal.reason: In S_RUN with trip_run = N, window_trip asserts once the run window holds ceil(N/2) faulted cycles instead of N, e.g. at 4 faulted cycles for trip_run = 8.

proposal.description: The entering sample is replicated across the run-count width instead of zero-extended, so a faulted cycle entering the S_RUN window adds all-ones (-1) to the count instead of +1.
proposal.reason: On the first faulted valley sample in S_RUN, fault_count_run_out wraps from 0 to 31 instead of rising to 1, and window_trip asserts for any trip_run up to 31.

proposal.description: The bit leaving the soft-start window is replicated across the count width instead of zero-extended, so a faulted cycle leaving the 32-cycle window adds one to fault_count_ss instead of subtracting one.
proposal.reason: In a soft start longer than 32 cycles, once a faulted sample ages out of the window fault_count_ss_out rises by 1 (rather than falling by 1), so the count overstates the window and window_trip_SS can assert with fewer than trip_ss faulted cycles present.

proposal.description: The new soft-start sample is replicated across the whole window register instead of being zero-extended into bit 0, so one faulted cycle marks every slot of the soft-start window as faulted.
proposal.reason: After one faulted valley sample in S_SS, the next sample sees a faulted bit leaving at WINDOW_SS-1 and decrements fault_count_ss (wrapping to 63 from 0), so fault_count_ss_out and window_trip_SS go wrong from the next cycle on.

proposal.description: The soft-start window counts a cycle as faulted only if the comparator was high on every clock of the blanking history (a debounce), instead of reading the one value from BLANK_CLKS clocks before high-side turn-on.
proposal.reason: In S_SS, if cp_sync is high BLANK_CLKS clocks before pwm rises but drops in any later clock before turn-on, the cycle is not counted, so fault_count_ss_out stays lower and window_trip_SS asserts late or not at all.

proposal.description: The soft-start window is sampled at high-side turn-off (the falling edge of pwm_sync, the peak) while the run window keeps using the valley at pwm_rise.
proposal.reason: In S_SS the sample reads the comparator from BLANK_CLKS clocks before PWM falls (during high-side conduction), so a comparator that is high only near the peak, or only at the valley, gives a different fault_count_ss_out and window_trip_SS than valley sampling does.

proposal.description: The soft-start trip compares count and threshold as signed values, so a trip_ss of 32 or more (top bit set) is read as a negative threshold.
proposal.reason: With trip_ss = 32 (a full-window threshold), window_trip_SS asserts as soon as S_SS is entered with zero faulted cycles, because 0 >= -32 is true.
